ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The bladder chart is in the violet folder. ... The wrist chart is in the yellow folder. ... The brain chart is in the beige folder. ... Which colour is the folder that holds the chart on the body part that does the thinking?" -> answer org beige; the alt prompt asks about the wrist (bridge alt), its 1st statement. Possible answers after the patch: yellow (answer of bridge alt's statement), violet (answer at the same statement slot), red (the alt prompt's own answer), beige (answer org kept).
